messages:
Priya (Marketing): Need a pared-down battlecard for next week's webinar: concise benchmark narrative vs managed cloud endpoints, three SDR one-liners, and two procurement rebut bullets.

Jordan (Product): Keep pillars tight: unified runtime (hosted/ded/private), cost controls (batching + KV cache), graceful degradation (model routing fallbacks).

Mateo (Eng-ML): Quick bench summary: redwood-v1 quant vs CloudX-managed shows ~25-35ms p95 benefit on chat, ~25-30% lower effective cost per 1k after batching on typical QPS. Sharing CSV shortly.

Sam (Sales): SDR one-liners (draft): 1) "Cut per-token spend with smart batching and cache." 2) "Predictable p95s engineered for production." 3) "Private control plane + KMS for compliant deployments." Keep <18 words.

Lila (Growth): Webinar headline test candidates: "Predictable inference. Predictable costs." and "Ship LLM features without surprise bills." Is running a quick headline AB.

Ava (Field): Procurement rebut bullets: 1) Managed cloud endpoints = convenience; Redwood = serving runtime + private VPC + rollout controls. 2) We provide measurable unit-econ levers (batching, cache, quant profiles) operators can tune.

Priya (Marketing): Actions: Mateo attach final numbers, Jordan add fallback flow blurb to battlecard, Lila run headline AB, Sam finalize SDR snippets and rebut bullets, Ava craft 2-slide demo script for live webinar.

launch-bot: Reminder: Battlecard draft due 2026-07-12 16:00 UTC.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks all  I'll assemble and circulate a compact battlecard by EOD Friday. Ping if blocked.
